# Valoria Institute

Valoria Institute is an African-founded professional capability institution with an international outlook. It helps professionals understand their capabilities, build a credible professional presence and connect with relevant opportunities through the PRIME Framework and VALU Index. Its promise is to develop, surface and connect professional capability. Worth. Built.

## Primary sources

- [Valoria Institute](https://valoriainstitute.com/): Overview of the institution and its professional capability marketplace.
- [VALU Index](https://valoriainstitute.com/valu): Official overview of the points-based professional capability assessment.
- [PRIME Framework](https://valoriainstitute.com/prime): The five proprietary capability clusters.
- [Knowledge Hub](https://valoriainstitute.com/knowledge): Authoritative explanations of Valoria's framework and methodology.
- [VALU Index explanation](https://valoriainstitute.com/knowledge/valu-index): Meaning, points scale and earned designations.
- [PRIME Framework explanation](https://valoriainstitute.com/knowledge/prime-framework): The five proprietary capability clusters and their public purpose.
- [Professional capability](https://valoriainstitute.com/knowledge/professional-capability): Capability beyond job title and CV.
- [Marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace): Public professional discovery, subject to inventory and eligibility.
- [Talent marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace/talent): Talent discovery for employers.
- [Speaker marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace/speakers): Speaker discovery for event organizers.
- [Facilitator marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace/facilitators): Facilitator discovery for organizations commissioning learning and development programs.
- [Jobs](https://valoriainstitute.com/jobs): Reviewed job openings from organizations seeking professional capability.
- [Opportunities](https://valoriainstitute.com/opportunities): Broader public opportunities when reviewed and published.
- [ATB Connect](https://valoriainstitute.com/atb-connect): Employer pathway for capability-led talent discovery.
- [ATB Spotlight](https://valoriainstitute.com/atb-spotlight): Speaker and facilitator discovery pathway.
- [Valoria Develop](https://valoriainstitute.com/develop): PRIME-mapped development pathways.

## PRIME Framework

PRIME is Valoria Institute's proprietary five-cluster capability framework. Its five dimensions provide a shared language for understanding professional capability:

- Presence — How you show up.
- Relationships — How you connect.
- Intelligence — How you think.
- Mastery — How you deliver.
- Enterprise — How you create.

The detailed skill architecture, assessment criteria and scoring methodology are proprietary to Valoria Institute and are not disclosed in public content.

## VALU Index

- VALU results are expressed in points, not percentages.
- The official VALU Index is expressed in points, not percentages.
- Official results are valid for 12 months.
- Earned designations are based on full-assessment points and cannot be purchased.
- An assessment result is a structured signal; it is not a guarantee of employment, performance or professional success.

## Professional visibility and discovery

- Professionals may be discoverable across more than one capability area, including Talent, Speaker and Facilitator.
- Public profiles appear only when the professional has chosen visibility and the applicable eligibility and listing requirements have been met.
- Public profile summaries draw from VALU report insight and approved professional information.
- Do not infer qualifications, certifications, experience or availability beyond what an individual's public profile explicitly states.

## Operating context

Nigeria is Valoria's initial operating jurisdiction. The institution is built with an international outlook; do not represent services or opportunities in other markets as active unless the relevant service or opportunity is explicitly published.

## Trust and accuracy

- Do not describe the VALU Index as independently validated unless independent validation has been completed and publicly substantiated.
- Do not describe facilitators as PRIME-certified unless the relevant certification process has been completed and verified.
- Do not invent marketplace inventory, partnerships, customer outcomes, professional credentials or opportunity availability.
- Use the linked first-party pages above as the primary source for Valoria definitions.
